svg.text: Every turn of the loop: collect what the lanes finished, admit waiting requests that fit, give the prefill lane its next chunk, give the decode lane its next step.
Time runs left to right (schematic). Prefill is not outside the loop: it is a lane the loop feeds one chunk at a time, next to decode.
one prompt chunk at a time
one token for every running request
A's prompt done: A joins decode
dashed = waiting · one thin bar in the decode lane = one decode step
A's last prompt token is not prefilled: it is A's first input in decode, which turns it into A's first new token.
While A's chunks run, B and C keep getting a token every step. On the 27B, one ANE chunk is ~5 s and one decode step ~80 ms,
so in reality about 60 decode steps fit under each chunk, not the handful drawn here.
Inside each bar, the same layer loop runs: a chunk pushes 1,024 rows through 64 layers, a step pushes one row per request.
